protocol_v1_mayor_choices.note: Protocol CHOICES frozen by Mayor; not verified capacity, not model accuracy, not designed for an MPC win.
protocol_v1_mayor_choices.prompt_length_class_distribution: uniform (each class probability 1/3 up to the <=2^-64 integer-mapping bias stated below)
protocol_v1_mayor_choices.later_gpu_config_requirement: prefix cache disabled (required for later GPU measurement; not verifiable or verified by this CPU component)

generator_construction.uniform_source: SHA-256 counter mode. X(purpose, seed, stream, k) = big-endian uint64 of the first 8 bytes of sha256(domain || k as 8-byte big-endian), domain = ASCII canonical JSON (separators ',' ':', no spaces) of [generator_id, generator_version, protocol_id, purpose, seed, stream] followed by one 0x00 byte. Streams: 'arrival' (k = arrival attempt index), 'length_class' (k = request index), 'payload' (k = request index). Python stdlib hashlib only; platform independent.
generator_construction.arrivals: Exact decimal arithmetic in an explicit decimal.Context(prec=50, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, traps InvalidOperation/DivisionByZero/Overflow); ln is correctly rounded by the decimal specification so results are interpreter independent. gap_seconds = (ln(2^64) - ln(2^64 - X)) / rate, i.e. an exponential(rate) inverse-CDF draw on the discrete uniform grid; X = 0 gives gap 0 (ties allowed); maximum gap 64 ln 2 / rate. t starts at 0 and accumulates; offset_ns = floor(t * 10^9) as an exact integer; generation stops at the first arrival with offset_ns >= duration_ns (equivalently t >= duration).
generator_construction.offer_cap: If an arrival inside the window would be offer number max_offers + 1, raise OfferCapExceeded: no truncation, no resampling, no reseeding; count == max_offers is allowed.
generator_construction.length_class: idx = (X * 3) >> 64 maps uint64 to {0, 1, 2} -> (256, 1024, 3072); class sizes differ by at most one uint64 value (relative bias <= 2^-64).
generator_construction.payload: nonce = 16 lowercase hex digits of X(payload); payload_key = protocol_id + '/' + purpose + '/' + request_id + '/' + nonce. The key seeds the SHARED prompt template only at replay-adapter time; tapes carry no prompt text.
generator_construction.request_ids: request_id_prefix + zero-padded 4-digit index (namespaces 'p0w1-train-' and 'p0w1-eval-' are disjoint).
generator_construction.split_independence: generate_split(protocol, purpose) reads only the shared protocol fields and that purpose's own split spec; the Train tape never contains the Eval seed/source/prefix and vice versa.

outputs.tape_format: canonical JSON bytes: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + newline; integers and strings only (no floats). Header: schema 'r24-resume-p0-offered-tape-v1', kind 'SYNTHETIC_OFFERED_WORKLOAD_TAPE', disclaimers, generator id/version, shared protocol fields, own split spec, rng spec, columns [request_id, offset_ns, requested_prompt_tokens, max_output_tokens, payload_key], rows, count.
outputs.manifest: ONE manifest.json for Train and Eval: protocol + canonical protocol sha256, module sha256, frozen CLI, per split file/sha256/bytes/count/seed/source_id/namespace/policy, holdout basis, prompt-length semantics, replay-adapter mapping and pilot command template (TTFT SLO and budget PENDING Mayor), claims not made. Deterministic: no timestamps, hostnames or interpreter versions inside.
outputs.eval_policy: held out: controllers/forecasters/tuning must never read the Eval tape or Eval outcomes; scenario information only from Train/past observations with a forecast RNG different from this generator's domains

replay_interface.finding: run_trace_pilot.py consumes trace_workload schema_version 1 traces whose requests carry prompt text and tokenizer-measured chat-template input_tokens (verify_prompts); the compact offered tape is therefore NOT directly parser compatible.
replay_interface.adapter: to_replay_trace(tape, model=..., prompt_for=..., count_tokens=..., tokenizer_sha256=None): input_tokens = MEASURED count from count_tokens(prompt), never assumed equal to the requested class; requested labels, payload keys, source id and tape sha kept in provenance; arrival_seconds = offset_ns / 1e9; max_tokens = output cap; refuses empty tapes, non-string prompts, non-integer/bool/non-positive counts and counts exceeding 8192 - cap; synthesis errors propagate (no retry, no new key).
replay_interface.real_tokenizer_step: NOT executed here (no tokenizer/GPU host); recipe recorded in the manifest.

tests_planned: spec conformance of the SHA-256 counter uniform source against an independently written domain literal
known-answer transforms: X=0 gap 0, X=2^64-1 gap 64 ln2/20, class boundaries at ceil(2^64/3) and ceil(2^65/3)
byte repeatability; Eval alone equals Eval generated after Train
time range [0, 5e9) ns, non-decreasing, 1 <= count <= 1024, class/cap values
split separation (disjoint IDs/keys/sources, no Eval spec in Train) and invariance (Eval bytes unchanged under Train spec changes and vice versa; same seed different purpose gives different streams)
max-offers refusal boundary: max = count passes, max = count - 1 raises
tape schema/canonical bytes (exact keys, ASCII, newline, integers only)
load_tape purpose guard, tamper and non-canonical refusal
replay adapter output passes ROOT/trace_workload.py validate_trace (imported by exact path) with fake prompt/count functions whose count differs from the requested class; refusal cases

run_protocol.failure_policy: Every attempt is preserved (run_attempt.sh noclobber). Only clear implementation defects may be fixed, in a new attempt number, with the failing source snapshotted and the amendment recorded in commands.log and AMENDMENTS.json; protocol constants, seeds, classes, cap, rate, duration and max_offers never change; tapes are generated once and never regenerated to change outcomes.
run_protocol.time_budget: first implementation checkpoint ~1 hour after 21:52Z start
